criteria:
MEOS-0, sixth stage: Experiments M-Q (world-state repair) and the derived readings.

  explore    every applicable repair action of ``repair6`` on every stress, over its magnitudes x durations x action ticks, on the exploration seeds (1-5). This is the raw material of M, N, O, P and of the cross-family matrix.
  validate   a setting that was effective on every exploration seed is run again on the validation seeds (6-10) and is *validated* only if it is effective on all of them. The two seed sets are never mixed.
  evaluate   the validated settings are evaluated on fresh seeds (11-30).
  M N O P    the coupling, resource, renewal and Address stresses with the actions of their own family (the cross-family matrix shows what the other families do to the same stress).
  Q          combined repairs on the stresses no single action recovers.

*Effective* (fixed here, before the runs were read): recovered or prevented at all three horizons (short, medium, long), with no secondary collapse and no exhausted resource field, on every seed of the set.
*Costly*: effective, but the energy rate needed to keep the run going exceeds 1.5 x the undamaged run's, or its collateral disturbance exceeds 1.0 (the scale of the undamaged run). *Unstable*: recovered at the short horizon and not at the medium or long one.
Every row of every run is saved; a null result is a result.
protocol:
Stage 6, Pipeline A: Experiments M-Q and the derived readings, on one protocol for single and combined repairs.

    PYTHONPATH=backend python backend/scripts/meos_experiments_stage6.py        # needs experiments_stage6_raw.jsonl.gz (meos_experiments_stage6_explore.py); about 4 minutes

Protocol (the same for a single action and for a pair), fixed before the runs were read:
  exploration  seeds 1-5   every setting; a setting that is *effective* on all five is a candidate.
  validation   seeds 6-10  every candidate is run again; it is *validated* only if it is effective on all five. A candidate that is effective on 3 or 4 of the 5 validation seeds, or a setting effective on 3 or 4 of the 5 exploration seeds, is a *near miss*:
               the data cannot separate it, it is kept and it makes the stress INCONCLUSIVE if nothing is validated.
  evaluation   seeds 11-30 validated settings and near misses are evaluated (reported; never used to choose).
Nothing is dropped: a candidate that failed validation is in the output with its validation result.

Writes docs/ecosystem/experiments_stage6.json and experiments_stage6_raw_combined.jsonl.gz.

actions.label: switch the M2 tap on (stage 5 internal reconfiguration; reference)
restore the coupling gain (full at 1.0, partial below)
actions.side_effect: none expected: the parameter returns to a value it had

actions.label: restore the coupling gain in steps of 5 ticks
actions.side_effect: intermediate gains pass through the dynamics

actions.label: temporary bridge: strengthen the coupling above baseline for a while, then return it to its (damaged) value
actions.side_effect: the damage remains after the bridge

actions.label: local bypass of the damaged coupling
actions.note: the coupling of MEOS-0 is one scalar share of A1's alteration reaching A2; there is no spatial coupling path to bypass, so no action is built

actions.label: resource pulse at A1's cell (graded by amount)
actions.side_effect: oversupply is a failure mode (stage 3: 2.0 recovers, 4.0 re-collapses)

actions.label: sustained inflow: raise regrow (and the charge in proportion) for a duration
actions.side_effect: a higher regrow rate is a different regime

actions.label: redistribution: raise the diffusion of the resource field for a duration
actions.side_effect: flattens the gradient the configurations use
actions.note: MEOS-0 has no operation that moves resource from one cell to another; diffusion is the nearest mechanism and is a proxy for redistribution

actions.label: reserve release: raise the power reserve (the energy reserve of the renewal system)
actions.note: the power reserve is energy for A2's renewal, not the resource field: a proxy for a local reserve release

actions.label: transport rerouting
actions.note: MEOS-0 has no transport network for the resource; no action is built

actions.label: restore the renewal efficiency (partial below 1.0)
restart renewal: reconnect the removed feedback
auxiliary renewal: raise how much resource A2 transfers per action step
temporary renewal: renewal efficiency above baseline for a duration, then back to the stressed value
restore the Address of A2 (also the refresh of a stale address)
local reconstruction: reassign A2 its Address at the cell it starts in
actions.side_effect: A2 is moved to (5, 6) with its state kept

actions.label: temporary local addressing
actions.note: no engine mode gives a bounded-duration local address (the ``stale`` and ``delayed`` modes are faults, not repairs)

actions.label: increase the sampling frequency (sampling interval 1)
actions.note: applied to the observation of a recorded run (analysis.observe), not to the run

actions.label: expand the observation region to the whole arena
actions.note: applied to the observation of a recorded run

actions.label: increase the spatial resolution (stride 1)
actions.note: applied to the observation of a recorded run
